rationale: F. prausnitzii catabolizes acetate, amino acids (arginine, proline), and formate under anaerobic conditions, producing butyrate as primary fermentation product with acetate and CO2 as co-products. Carbon is limiting at this stage; uptake of 40.5 mmol C/gDW/h minus 30 mmol C/gDW/h output leaves 10.5 mmol C/gDW/h for biomass, supporting 0.32 /h growth. Nitrogen (4.0 mmol/gDW/h) is sufficient.
